description: This file contains utility functions for handling DirectUrl objects in the pip package manager. It includes functions to convert DirectUrl objects to requirement strings, create DirectUrls for editable sources, and generate DirectUrls from links, especially VCS and archive types.

classes.name: DirectUrl
classes.description: Represents a direct URL with associated metadata, used for specifying source distributions, VCS, or archive links.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Represents a parsed URL with optional VCS or hash information, used for dependency resolution and source lookup.

methods.name: str direct_url_as_pep440_direct_reference(direct_url: DirectUrl, name: str)
methods.description: Converts a DirectUrl object into a PEP 440 compliant requirement string with optional fragments.

methods.name: DirectUrl direct_url_for_editable(source_dir: str)
methods.description: Creates a DirectUrl object pointing to an editable source directory.

methods.name: DirectUrl direct_url_from_link( link: Link, source_dir: Optional[str] = None, link_is_in_wheel_cache: bool = False )
methods.description: Generates a DirectUrl object from a Link instance, handling VCS, directory, and archive types.

ctags.name: direct_url_from_link
ctags.signature: ( link: Link, source_dir: Optional[str] = None, link_is_in_wheel_cache: bool = False )
